name: proof stat and side-by-side comparison cards
looks: A short claim about picking real winners, not guesses, sits over a small thumbnail card and a bold multiplier number that rolls up, with a thin bar filling underneath to show how far past average it lands. It cuts to a second claim about making a version your own, with two interface cards side by side, one showing a breakdown of what worked and the other a new title idea built from it.
build: The multiplier number rolls up under a vertical blur that clears as it settles, with a bar filling on power3.out beside it (the data-infographic mechanic). The two comparison cards are flat DOM panels with mono labels, swapped on a hard cut.
sound: A rising tone under the number roll-up, a soft pop as the bar settles, a light blip on the card swap.
prompt: Pair a bold, rolled-up multiplier number with a thin bar that fills to show a result far past average, under a claim about proof instead of guessing, then cut to two flat interface cards side by side comparing someone else's approach with your own version of the same idea.
